contextWindow.sourceRef: Current server-delivered Codex model catalogue (~/.codex/models_cache.json, fetched_at 2026-10-07T07:59:47.410248Z): max_context_window 872,000 for this model. codex-rs (openai/codex a6baf88) defines that field as the "Maximum context window allowed for config overrides" (protocol/src/openai_models.rs), and models-manager/src/model_info.rs clamps a configured model_context_window to it (context_window.min(max_context_window)) -- so the backend serves a conversation up to 872,000 tokens when the client opts in, as a Codex user does with model_context_window in config.toml. The catalogue's context_window 272,000 is Codex's DEFAULT, the point its own client compacts at, not what the backend accepts.
